title: DMA buffer zeroing after MapAllocatedPages to prevent garbage audio on first stream

summary.behavior: AllocateBufferWithNotification now calls RtlZeroMemory on the mapped DMA buffer immediately after MapAllocatedPages succeeds, so the first stream start does not expose stale physical page contents to the audio pipeline.
summary.scope_boundary: Source + local WDK build + Inf2Cat signability + user-space contract tests only. No guest installation, driver load, PnP start, audio delivery, HLK or Microsoft signing claim.

validation.result: pass; HibikiVirtualAudio.sys linked; Inf2Cat 0 errors / 0 warnings
